parameters.name: Config
parameters.description:
The switch status. Valid values:

- **on**: Enable
- **off**: Disable

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: NoTargetAsOn
parameters.description:
Specifies whether asset configuration is required. Default value: **false**. Valid values:
- **true**: Required
- **false**: Not required
> This value takes effect only when **config** is set to **on**.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The switch type. Valid values:

- **auto_breaking**: Anti-virus
- **ransomware_breaking**: Anti-ransomware (bait capture)
- **webshell\_cloud_breaking**: Website backdoor connection defense
- **alinet**: Malicious network behavior defense
- **k8s\_log_analysis**: Container K8s threat detection
- **alisecguard**: Client self-protection defense mode
